hero.title: Mmezu Obodo & Ihe Akaebe Nnyocha
hero.subtitle: Ebe obodo mepere emepe nke dabeere na eziokwu na ihe akaebe, na-egosi mgbanwe iwu, nnukwu ọrụ mmepe, na nsonaazụ ọma n'okpuru ọchịchị Onyeisi Ala Bola Ahmed Tinubu.
hero.statement1: Lee ezigbo ihe akaebe doro anya n'azụ ọganihu obodo.
hero.statement2: Soro mgbanwe iwu site na mbipụta gọọmentị ruo na nsonaazụ doro anya.
hero.statement3: Nyochaa nnukwu ọrụ, mmemme ọdịmma ọha, na iwu obodo Naịjirịa.
hero.statement4: Lelee ndekọ nwere njikọ na isi mmalite ihe akaebe.
hero.statement5: Ndekọ ọganihu obodo. Enwere ike ịchọ. Enwere ike isoro. Dabeere na ihe akaebe.
